name: editor
notes: Draw editor, controls, hit-test; runs begin+complete action handlers

name: editor_drag_release
notes: Editor variant used while dragged placement/palette interaction is resolving; runs complete action handler

name: preview_setup
notes: Copies selected firework type into preview event and advances

name: preview_playback
notes: Decodes selected firework Bink in editor preview area; restarts movie and advances at end

name: preview_finish
notes: Draws editor and resets internal state to 0

name: show_setup
notes: Stops managed sounds, unloads editor resources, loads Bink bank, initializes show timing/events

name: delete_selected
notes: Draw/editor controls; placement click calls DeleteFireworkAtSelectedRegion

name: completion_movie_setup
notes: Waits for sound state, clears display, opens fireworkcomplete.bik, enters state 15

name: completion_movie_playback
notes: Runs global Bink movie; after completion returns through show setup/completion sound path

name: complete_and_exit
notes: Updates progress, outer flow -> 0x3C, saves firedata and unloads resources
